lessons_used: Predictions generally overestimate noise-corrected results, though some winning tests (like adoption new_screen) exceeded expectations.

Evidence for sign_in, copy, sign_in, reorder, and adoption, redesign changes remains thin due to contradictory results or lack of consistent wins.

candidates.title: Custom pet photo validation stage
candidates.change: Insert a dedicated photo clarity verification screen before certificate generation to prevent custom pet visual glitches or setup failures.
candidates.why: 3 support emails reported that custom pet creation fails or results in distorted visual renders.

new_photo_check.headline: Verify Photo Quality
new_photo_check.body: Make sure your uploaded photo is clear and well-lit to ensure your desktop pet generates properly.

guard.reason: Adding a photo clarity check screen inside onboarding is allowed under rule 4.

candidates.score_note: New screen targeted at adoption step where conversion is 74.5%; single prior test showed +7.2% lift, but cost is high due to creating a new screen.

candidates.title: Stage layout for home introduction
candidates.change: Redesign the home_intro screen into a stage layout emphasizing key desktop controls and interaction shortcuts.
candidates.why: Finish step conversion dropped to 64.8% with 5815s mean time, and 3 support tickets noted confusion over controlling or hiding the pet.

home_intro.headline: Your Companion is Ready for Desktop Life
home_intro.body: Learn how to summon, move, or minimize your new companion anytime from your desktop taskbar.

guard.reason: Redesigning the home intro screen while keeping its core function is permitted under rules 2 and 4.

candidates.score_note: Finish step has the largest funnel drop (64.8%), but prior finish redesign yielded only +0.1% with no clear effect pattern.

candidates.title: Desktop rendering pipeline explanation notice
candidates.change: Display step-by-step rendering engine startup notices on the waiting screen while the pet initializes on screen.
candidates.why: Home waiting screen shows a long mean duration (2336s) and 3 support emails reported pets failing to show up on the desktop.

waiting.headline: Building Desktop Companion Surface
waiting.body: 1. Initializing graphics engine. 2. Anchoring companion overlay. 3. Finalizing interactive animations.

guard.reason: Updating waiting screen information and status notices is allowed under rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Cheap config change, but 4 previous tests for home wait_info showed no clear effect (+0.6% average).

candidates.title: Position sign-in screen before path selection
candidates.change: Move sign-in to occur right after the story screen so user account sync is established prior to pet creation.
candidates.why: 8 support emails cited missing or reset pets after signing in again, making early account binding crucial.

guard.reason: sign_in may move later, not before choose_path

candidates.title: Multi-device pet save reassurance text
candidates.change: Update the sign-in prompt body text to explicitly clarify that logging in preserves pet progress across reinstallations and device changes.
candidates.why: Top support issue (8 emails) involved missing or reset pets after signing in again.

sign_in.body: Signing in secures your pet's memory, traits, and progress across device reinstalls and upgrades.

guard.reason: Updating sign-in copy to clarify device sync features is allowed inside onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Strongest evidence from support (8 emails); low cost text change with moderate confidence (+1.5% average across 3 tests).

candidates.title: Path selection flexibility hint
candidates.change: Add an explicit hint explaining that choosing a premade path does not prevent users from making custom pets later.
candidates.why: Choose_path step has a 514s mean duration, indicating user hesitation about path commitment.

choose_path.hint: You can always create additional custom pets or adjust settings after onboarding!

guard.reason: Adding a helpful hint to the choose path screen is permitted and maintains all core requirements.

candidates.score_note: Low cost hint change, but choose_path hint tests showed no clear positive effect (-0.6% across 2 tests) and evidence lacks support tickets.

candidates.title: Split layout for adoption certificate screen
candidates.change: Switch adoption certificate layout to split view, presenting companion stats side-by-side with certificate details.
candidates.why: Adoption conversion is 74.5% with high median completion time (89s).

guard.reason: Switching to a split layout for the adoption certificate screen is allowed under rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Adoption layout change previously measured -2.9% relative drop; evidence from support is lacking.

candidates.title: Companion quick summon diagnostic flow
candidates.change: Add an interactive quick-summon button component on the waiting screen to verify desktop overlay rendering.
candidates.why: 3 support tickets reported pet not appearing on desktop or app failing to open during launch.

guard.reason: Adding a next action button to the waiting screen makes the mandatory waiting step skippable.

candidates.title: First care accessory completion reward
candidates.change: Highlight an exclusive starter toy item unlocked on the final onboarding screen to incentivize completing setup.
candidates.why: Finish step drop-off is high (64.8% completion) with long completion times.

guard.reason: Onboarding copy cannot mention gifts, unlocked items, or free extras.

candidates.title: Desktop notification toggle on final view
candidates.change: Enable a desktop notification toggle on the finish screen so users stay alerted when their desktop pet needs care.
candidates.why: 4 support emails complained about desktop feature misbehavior or missing notifications after setup.

home_intro.hint: Enable notifications so your companion can alert you on your desktop when it wants to play.

guard.reason: Adding notification settings on the home intro screen is allowed under rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Targets the high-drop finish step with 4 support tickets; single prior test yielded +1.3% lift.
